What's Changed

  • feat(markdown): render AI translation results with formatting by @leozanee in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1161
  • feat(shortcut): add a global shortcut to toggle select translation by @bsythegreat in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1203
  • feat(claude-code): default the translation model to Sonnet by @sonhyrd in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1211
  • fix(window): restore input focus after query window layout changes by @MoonMao42 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1212
  • feat(localization): add Japanese support by @syrupfresh in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1202
  • feat(localization): add Spanish (es_ES) support by @terorero in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1138
  • build(deps): bump concurrent-ruby from 1.3.6 to 1.3.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1219
  • feat(localization): add Catalan support by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1218
  • refactor(stream): support reasoning effort across shared streaming services by @bsythegreat in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1204
  • fix(window): show the floating query window as a nonactivating panel by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1223
  • fix(mdict): stabilize WebView dictionary rendering by @KurodaKayn in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1222
  • fix(ocr): prevent Vision OCR crashes and improve error handling by @ct-jyjntc in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1221
  • fix(google): support distinct English TTS accents by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1243
  • fix(mdict): restore anchor navigation and dark-mode text by @KurodaKayn in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1244
  • feat(query): add an option to translate automatically while typing by @bsythegreat in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1205
  • fix(selection): disable automatic text capture in screen-mirroring apps by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1255
  • feat(settings): support adding and removing services from the service list by @MoonMao42 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1207
  • fix(query): reduce WebView resource churn in query results by @MoonMao42 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1225
  • fix(settings): resolve macOS 27 sidebar and title bar layout conflicts by @itzLan1126 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1258
  • feat(history): include translations in history and favorites exports by @ZhangDaniel942 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1220
  • docs: recommend a tool for recurring permission prompts during local development by @MoonMao42 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1210
  • docs(agents): complete the Agent documentation restructure by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1264
  • fix(signing): read the Team ID from the certificate OU by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1265
  • fix(readme): repair the broken Star History chart by @Dessalines39394 in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1267
  • feat(star-history): generate Star History as a repository-owned artifact by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1268
  • chore(star-history): update generated assets by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1272
  • fix(deepl): migrate web translation to the oneshot endpoint by @tisfeng in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1271
  • fix(app): disable the macOS 26 Tahoe AutoFill heuristics helper by @mrasong in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1269

New Contributors

  • @leozanee made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1161
  • @sonhyrd made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1211
  • @syrupfresh made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1202
  • @terorero made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1138
  • @ct-jyjntc made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1221
  • @itzLan1126 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1258
  • @ZhangDaniel942 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1220
  • @Dessalines39394 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1267
  • @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1272
  • @mrasong made their first contribution in https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/pull/1269

Full Changelog: https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict/compare/2.21.0...2.22.0
